15700.meaning1: with possession as source; originating from appropriation

examples.text: idaṃ kho dukkhaṃ upadhinidānaṃ upadhisamudayaṃ upadhijātikaṃ upadhipabhavaṃ, upadhismiṃ sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti, upadhismiṃ asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hotī'ti.

15701.meaning1: pleasure of possession; happiness based on attachment

examples.text: katamāni dve? upadhisukhañ'ca nirupadhisukhañ'ca. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve sukhāni.

15702.meaning1: detachment from attachment; disengagement from identification; (comm) detachment from sensual pleasures
15702.meaning2: seclusion from the acquisitions; solitude from attachment

examples.text: idh'ānanda, bhikkhu upadhivivekā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānā sabbaso kāyaduṭṭhullānaṃ paṭippassaddhiyā vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

15703.meaning1: resulting in underlying attachment; resulting in taking as mine; having the consequence of identification

examples.text: sammādiṭṭhiṃ'p'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, dvayaṃ vadāmi. atthi, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi sāsavā puññabhāgiyā upadhivepakkā, atthi, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi ariyā anāsavā lok'uttarā magg'aṅgā.

15704.meaning2: places upon; lays down, imposes; gives in addition, hands over; places under oneself, lies down upon

15706.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of upanagara

examples.text: nagarassa samīpe pavattati kathā iti upanagaraṃ, darathānaṃ abhāvo niddarathaṃ, makasānaṃ abhāvo nimmakasaṃ, vuḍḍhānaṃ paṭipāṭi yathāvuḍḍhaṃ

15707.commentary: (DNa) upanaccantiyā'ti naccamānāya. sā kira ekasmiṃ samaye cātumahārājikadevehi saddhiṃ sakkassa devarājassa naccaṃ dassan'atthāya gatā, tasmiñ'ca khaṇe sakko tathāgatassa aṭṭha yathābhucce guṇe payirudāhāsi. evaṃ tasmiṃ divase gantvā naccantī assosi. (DNt) upanaccantiyā'ti upagantvā naccantiyā.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, bhante, bhaddā sūriyavacchasā maṃ etadavoca, na kho me, mārisa, so bhagavā sammukhā diṭṭho api ca suto'y'eva me so bhagavā devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sudhammāyaṃ sabhāyaṃ upanaccantiyā.

15710.meaning1: name of the military general of Magadha

examples.text: evaṃ vutte vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamah'āmatto upanandaṃ senāpatiṃ āmantesi, taṃ kiṃ maññati bhavaṃ senāpati yadime bhonto sakkātabbaṃ sakkaronti, garuṃ kātabbaṃ garuṃ karonti, mānetabbaṃ mānenti, pūjetabbaṃ pūjenti?

15711.meaning1: name of four privately awakened Buddhas
15711.commentary: (MNa) ānando nando upanando dvādasā'ti cattāro ānandā, cattāro nandā cattāro upanandā'ti evaṃ dvādasa.

examples.text: durannayo saṅgho atho'pi ujjayo, aparo muni sayho anomanikkamo, ānando nando upanando dvādasa, bhāradvājo antimadehadhārī.

15715.meaning2: having the characteristic feature of binding onto

examples.text: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū mahānāme sakke upanandhiṃsu.

15717.meaning2: bends on, comes near, is present

examples.text: nihīyati puriso nihīnasevī, na ca hāyetha kadāci tulyasevī, seṭṭham'upanamaṃ udeti khippaṃ, tasmā attano uttariṃ bhajethā'ti.
ādittaṃ celaṃ vā sīsaṃ vā ajjhupekkhitvā'pi bhāvan'āvasena attano citte upanayaṃ arahatī'ti opaneyyiko.

so tena puññakammena sugatīsu'y'eva saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde sāvatthiyaṃ brāhmaṇamahāsālassa gehe nibbattitvā yāva sattavassāni, tāva antoghare'y'eva vaḍḍhitvā sattame saṃvacchare upanayan'atthaṃ uyyānaṃ nīto antarāmagge jiṇṇ'āturamate disvā tesaṃ adiṭṭhapubbattā te parijane pucchitvā…

15727.meaning1: resents; bears a grudge; harbours enmity (towards)

examples.text: akkocchi maṃ avadhi maṃ, ajini maṃ ahāsi me, ye ca taṃ upanayhanti, veraṃ tesaṃ na sammati.
pūtimacchaṃ kus'aggena, yo naro upanayhati, kusā'pi pūti vāyanti, evaṃ bāl'ūpasevanā.
tagarañ'ca palāsena, yo naro upanayhati, pattā'pi surabhi vāyanti, evaṃ dhīr'ūpasevanā.

15733.meaning2: done for the sake of offering

15734.meaning2: makes bends towards, makes touch; brings near, hands (to); holds out, offers, presents

15736.commentary: (DNa) bhagavato kāyaṃ upanāmitan'ti nivāsanapārupanavasena allīyāpitaṃ. bhagavā'pi tato ekaṃ nivāsesi, ekaṃ pārupi.

examples.text: idaṃ, bhante, siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugamaṭṭhaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ bhagavato kāyaṃ upanāmitaṃ hat'accikaṃ viya khāyatī'ti.

15737.meaning1: (of food) should be served; should be offered (to)
15737.meaningLit: to cause to be bent near

examples.text: sace yāgu hoti, bhājanaṃ dhovitvā yāgu upanāmetabbā. yāguṃ pītassa udakaṃ datvā bhājanaṃ paṭiggahetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ appaṭighaṃsantena dhovitvā paṭisāmetabbaṃ.

15738.meaning1: (of food) serves; brings near; takes the next mouthful

examples.text: dvattikkhattuṃ kho bhavaṃ gotamo mukhe ālopaṃ samparivattetvā ajjhoharati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā asambhinnā kāyaṃ pavisati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā mukhe avasiṭṭhā hoti, ath'āparaṃ ālopaṃ upanāmeti.
atha kho kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo mahatiyā kaṃsapātiyā pāyāsaṃ vaḍḍhetvā bhagavato upanāmesi, bhuñjatu bhavaṃ gotamo pāyasaṃ.
purimāni, bhante, divasāni purimatarāni tadah'uposathe pannarase vassa-upanāyikāya puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā kevalakappā ca devā tāvatiṃsā sudhammāyaṃ sabhāyaṃ sannisinnā honti sannipatitā.

te upakaṭṭhāya vassa-upanāyikāya pañcasatatāpase himavantato āgantvā nagare bhikkhāya carante disvā pasīditvā nisīdāpetvā bhojetvā paṭiññaṃ gahetvā cattāro māse attano santike vasāpetvā puna vassāratte āgaman'atthāya paṭijānāpetvā uyyojesuṃ.

15741.meaning1: relating to; referring to; regarding; applying to

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu anabhijānaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ att'upanāyikaṃ alam'ariyañāṇadassanaṃ samudācareyya iti jānāmi, iti passāmī'ti

15742.meaning1: resentment; bearing a grudge; harbouring enmity; rancour
15742.commentary: (MNa) upanandhanalakkhaṇo upanāho, vera appaṭinissajjanaraso, kodh'ānupabandha-bhāva-paccupaṭṭhāno. vuttañ'c'etaṃ, pubbakāle kodho, aparakāle upanāho'tiādi

examples.text: upanāho cittassa upakkileso'ti, iti viditvā upanāhaṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahati.
upanāhissa upanāho appahīno hoti, makkhissa makkho appahīno hoti, paḷāsissa paḷāso appahīno hoti, issukissa issā appahīnā hoti, maccharissa macchariyaṃ appahīnaṃ hoti

15743.meaning1: removal of resentment; dispelling of a grudge

examples.text: katame dve? kodhavinayo ca upanāhavinayo ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve dhammā'ti.

15744.meaning1: resentful; who bears a grudge; who harbours enmity; who is vengeful; having rancour
15744.commentary: (MNa) upanāhī'ti upanāhanasīlā, upanāho vā etesaṃ atthī'ti upanāhī. (SNPa) upanāhī'ti tass'eva kodhassa daḷhīkammena upanāhena samannāgato.

examples.text: kodhano upanāhī ca, pāpamakkhī ca yo naro, vipannadiṭṭhi māyāvī, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.
upanāhissa upanāho appahīno hoti, makkhissa makkho appahīno hoti, paḷāsissa paḷāso appahīno hoti, issukissa issā appahīnā hoti, maccharissa macchariyaṃ appahīnaṃ hoti
ahaṃ middhena pakato, vihārā upanikkhamiṃ, caṅkamaṃ abhiruhanto, tatth'eva papatiṃ chamā.

15748.meaning2: placed by, laid down, set out

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu jātarūparajataṃ uggaṇheyya vā uggaṇhāpeyya vā upanikkhittaṃ vā sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
upanikkhittaṃ vā sādiyeyyā'ti idaṃ ayyassa hotū'ti upanikkhittaṃ sādiyati, nissaggiyaṃ hoti.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso sinerussa pabbatarājassa satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhipeyya. taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ, yā vā satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhittā, yo vā sinerupabbatarājā'ti?

15751.meaning1: putting down; depositing near; placing at hand
15751.commentary: (VINa) upanikkhipanaṃ nāma samīpe nikkhipanaṃ. tattha yo iminā asinā mato so dhanaṃ vā labhatī'ti-ādinā nayena maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇetvā iminā maraṇ'atthikā marantu, māraṇatthikā mārentū'ti vā vatvā asiṃ upanikkhipati, tassa upanikkhipane dukkaṭaṃ.

examples.text: upanikkhipanaṃ nāma asiṃ vā sattiṃ vā bheṇḍiṃ vā laguḷaṃ vā pāsāṇaṃ vā satthaṃ vā visaṃ vā rajjuṃ vā upanikkhipati, iminā marissatī'ti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

15752.meaning2: deposited near, laid up, set out

15753.meaning1: having placed close (to); having deposited near
15753.commentary: (VINa) upanikkhipitvā detī'ti bhūmiyaṃ ṭhapetvā idaṃ ayya tumhākaṃ dammī'ti deti, evaṃ dinnaṃ sādhu bhaginī'ti sampaṭicchitvā tāya eva vā bhikkhuniyā aññena vā kenaci paṭiggahāpetvā bhuñjituṃ vaṭṭati.

examples.text: anāpatti dāpeti na deti, upanikkhipitvā deti, bāhir'ālepaṃ deti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

15755.commentary: (SNa) yāva'd'eva upanikkhepanamattāyā'ti tiyojanasahassavitthārassa himavato santike ṭhapitā sāsapamattā pāsāṇasakkharā himavā nu kho mahā, ayaṃ nu kho pāsāṇasakkharā'ti evaṃ yāva upanikkhepanamattass'eva atthāya bhaveyyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. parato'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, himavato pabbatarājassa parittā pāsāṇasakkharā yāva'd'eva upanikkhepanamattāya, evam'eva kho mayaṃ āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa yāva'd'eva upanikkhepanamattāya. āyasmā hi mahāmoggallāno mah'iddhiko mah'ānubhāvo ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ tiṭṭheyyā'ti.

15756.meaning1: placing next to (for the purpose of comparison)
15756.commentary: (SNa) yāva'd'eva upanikkhepanamattāyā'ti tiyojanasahassavitthārassa himavato santike ṭhapitā sāsapamattā pāsāṇasakkharā himavā nu kho mahā, ayaṃ nu kho pāsāṇasakkharā'ti evaṃ yāva upanikkhepanamattass'eva atthāya bhaveyyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. parato'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, himavato pabbatarājassa parittā pāsāṇasakkharā yāva'd'eva upanikkhepanamattāya, evam'eva kho mayaṃ āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa yāva'd'eva upanikkhepanamattāya. āyasmā hi mahāmoggallāno mah'iddhiko mah'ānubhāvo ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ tiṭṭheyyā'ti.

15759.meaning2: rubbing against, pressing up near to

examples.text: jhāyanto'ti lakkhaṇa-upanijjhānena ca ārammaṇa-upanijjhānena ca jhāyanto. tattha lakkhaṇa-upanijjhānaṃ nāma vipassanāmaggaphalāni. vipassanā hi tīṇi lakkhaṇāni upanijjhāyatī'ti lakkhaṇa-upanijjhānaṃ.

vipassanā hi tīṇi lakkhaṇāni upanijjhāyatī'ti lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānaṃ. maggo vipassanāya āgatakiccaṃ sādhetī'ti lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānaṃ. phalaṃ tathalakkhaṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ upanijjhāyatī'ti lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānaṃ.

15764.meaning1: regards with envy; is jealous of

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, manopadosikā nāma devā, te ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyanti. te ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññam'aññamhi cittāni padūsenti.
api ca kho mātugāmassa cakkhunā cakkhuṃ upanijjhāyati pekkhati
aṭṭha samāpattiyo pana kasiṇ'ārammaṇassa upanijjhāyanato ārammaṇ'ūpanijjhānan'ti veditabbā.

15767.meaning1: regarding with envy; being jealous of

examples.text: te ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññam'aññamhi cittāni padūsenti. te aññam'aññaṃ paduṭṭhacittā kilantakāyā kilantacittā. te devā tamhā kāyā cavanti.

15768.meaning1: regarded with envy; was jealous of

examples.text: ye pana mayaṃ ahumhā manopadosikā, te mayaṃ ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyimhā. te mayaṃ ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññam'aññamhi cittāni padūsimhā, te mayaṃ aññam'aññaṃ paduṭṭhacittā kilantakāyā kilantacittā.

15769.meaning1: reflected upon; thought over; meditated upon

examples.text: yaṃ, bhikkhave, sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya idaṃ saccan'ti upanijjhāyitaṃ ta'dam'ariyānaṃ etaṃ musā'ti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ, ayam'ek'ānupassanā.

15771.commentary: (MNa) upanidham'pī'ti upanikkhepanamattam'pi na upeti, olokentassa olokitamattam'pi n'atthi.

examples.text: saṅkham'pi na upenti, upanidham'pi na upenti, kalabhāgam'pi na upenti sinerupabbatarājānaṃ upanidhāya satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhittā'ti.

15774.grammar: ger of upa ni √dhā, trans (+acc or +gen)

examples.text: saṅkham'pi na upeti upanidhim'pi na upeti kalabhāgam'pi na upeti mahāpathaviṃ upanidhāya bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito'ti.

kiñ'hi sobhati chavo manodaṇḍo imassa evaṃ oḷārikassa kāyadaṇḍassa upanidhāya! atha kho kāyadaṇḍo'va mahāsāvajjataro pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā, no tathā vacīdaṇḍo, no tathā manodaṇḍo'ti.
saṅkham'pi na upeti upanidhim'pi na upeti kalabhāgam'pi na upeti mahāpathaviṃ upanidhāya bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito'ti.

15776.meaning1: deposit; stash; property put under the care of another; entrusted item
15776.commentary: (VMVt) oṇirakkhassa santike ṭhapitabhaṇḍaṃ upanidhi viya guttaṭṭhāne ṭhapetvā saṅgopan'atthāya anikkhipitvā yathāṭhapitaṭṭhāne eva muhuttamattaṃ olokan'atthāya ṭhapitattā tassa bhaṇḍassa ṭhānācāvanamattena oṇirakkhakassa pārājikaṃ hoti.

examples.text: upanidhi nāma upanikkhittaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ. dehi me bhaṇḍan'ti vuccamāno n'āhaṃ gaṇhāmī'ti bhaṇati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

15778.meaning1: lies down next to; lies down around

examples.text: so gacchati ce'pi tam'eva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upagacchati. tiṭṭhati ce'pi tam'eva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upatiṭṭhati. nisīdati ce'pi tam'eva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upanisīdati. nipajjati ce'pi tam'eva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upanipajjati.
yadā kho te, bhikkhave, chappāṇakā jhattā assu kilantā, atha tam'eva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upatiṭṭheyyuṃ, upanisīdeyyuṃ, upanipajjeyyuṃ.
nisajjaṃ kappeyyā'ti mātugāme nisinne bhikkhu upanisinno vā hoti upanipanno vā. bhikkhu nisinne mātugāmo upanisinno vā hoti upanipanno vā. ubho vā nisinnā honti ubho vā nipannā.

15782.synonym: gadhita, nibandhita, paṭibaddha, paṭimukka, patibaddha, baddha, bandhāpita

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, sā gaddulabaddho daḷhe khīle vā thambhe vā upanibaddho. so gacchati ce'pi tam'eva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upagacchati.
daḷhāya rajjuyā bandhitvā daḷhe khīle vā thambhe vā upanibandheyya. atha kho te, bhikkhave, chappāṇakā nānāvisayā nānāgocarā sakaṃ sakaṃ gocaravisayaṃ āviñcheyyuṃ.

seyyathā'pi, aggivessana, hatthidamako mahantaṃ thambhaṃ pathaviyaṃ nikhaṇitvā āraññakassa nāgassa gīvāyaṃ upanibandhati āraññakānañ'c'eva sīlānaṃ abhinimmadanāya āraññakānañ'c'eva sarasaṅkappānaṃ abhinimmadanāya

evam'eva kho, aggivessana, ariyasāvakassa ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā cetaso upanibandhanā honti gehasitānañ'c'eva sīlānaṃ abhinimmadanāya gehasitānañ'c'eva sarasaṅkappānaṃ abhinimmadanāya gehasitānañ'c'eva darathakilamathapariḷāhānaṃ abhinimmadanāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya.
jīvako… janaṃ ussāretvā tirokaraṇiyaṃ parikkhipitvā thambhe upanibandhitvā bhariyaṃ purato ṭhapetvā udaracchaviṃ uppāṭetvā antagaṇṭhiṃ nīharitvā bhariyāya dassesi.

15793.commentary: (DNa) akkharaṃ upanibbattan'ti saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro uppanno.

examples.text: khettānaṃ adhipatī'ti kho, vāseṭṭha, khattiyo, khattiyo tv'eva dutiyaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ. dhammena pare rañjetī'ti kho, vāseṭṭha, rājā, rājā tv'eva tatiyaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.

15794.synonym: upama, opama, disa, nibha, paṭibhāga, patirūpaka, saṅkāsa, sadisa, sadisopama, sannibha, sappaṭibhāga, sarikkhaka, sarūpa, saṃkāsa

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni setāni saṅkhavaṇṇa-upanibhāni

15797.meaning1: is led onwards; is carried (towards) (aging and death)
15797.meaning2: is brought near; is alluded to; is brought to the end
15797.commentary: (MNa) upaniyyatī'ti jarāmaraṇasantikaṃ gacchati, āyukkhayena vā tattha niyyati.

examples.text: upaniyyati loko addhuvo'ti, bhavaṃ raṭṭhapālo āha. imassa, bho raṭṭhapāla, bhāsitassa kathaṃ attho daṭṭhabbo'ti?

15798.construction:
upa + ni + √si + ā + a
upanisā + a
15798.commentary: (DNa) candass'upanisā devā, candam'āguṃ purakkhatvā'ti candanissitakā devā candaṃ purato katvā āgatā.

examples.text: veṇḍudevā sahali ca, asamā ca duve yamā, candassa-upanisā devā, candam'āguṃ purakkhatvā.

15799.meaning1: caused by; as precondition; as prerequisite
15799.construction:
upa + ni + √si + ā + a
upanisā + a
